brief: Two-storey brick newspaper office and print shop of the 1840s with a stepped-parapet gable front and a painted name; a frame shed behind. Record gap: 2 photos.

facade.notes: the Times and Seasons newspaper office and print shop (Nauvoo IL, 1845): a row of three small Federal brick buildings -- a gable-front one lettered 'TIMES & SEASONS', a five-bay one, a stepped-gable one with 'PRINT SHOP' -- on a snowy green with a zig-zag split-rail fence (a restored historic site)

why.note: the 1840s village's commercial buildings looked like houses: brick boxes with a sign
